_comment: Single source of truth for LLM INFERENCE constants — diversity temperature, dedup, retry, rate-limit floor. Both drivers (HS api_common.lua and AHK api_common.ahk) load this file at boot. Change a value here and it propagates to both backends in lockstep.

diversity_temperature._comment: Per-variant temperature increment when generating N predictions sequentially. The step depends on the user's base temperature: low base → bigger step to compensate, high base → smaller step so variants stay coherent. effective_base raises a low base to 0.20 starting at variant 2 so the first variant stays faithful to the user's setting but the following ones have headroom.

dedup._comment: Exact-text deduplication of predictions. When two variants produce the same to_type string, the second is dropped and counted as a duplicate.

retry._comment: On a per-variant failure (HTTP error, empty completion, parse failure), the sequential fetch retries up to max_multiplier × requested_predictions attempts in total. retry_temperature_step is added on top of the diversity step for the second attempt.

rate_limit_min_interval_ms._comment: Minimum interval between two consecutive prediction requests per backend. Floors the user's debounce so paid API providers are protected from per-keystroke token burn, and local backends save GPU energy on back-to-back calls.
